title: Oozy Winey Vietnamese Pork Bun Bo Hue
description: A winey and fluffy Vietnamese dish featuring pork and Appleton rum, served in a tagliere vessel, this solo dinner is sugar free friendly and made in the form of bun bo hue.
instructions: In a large pot, combine pork shoulder, Appleton rum, fish sauce, lime juice, grated ginger, and garlic, and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and add the marinated pork, cooking until browned on all sides.
Add the shallots and lemongrass to the skillet and cook until the shallots are translucent.
Wrap each portion of the pork mixture in a banana leaf and steam for 10 minutes.
Serve the steamed pork in a tagliere vessel.
Garnish with additional grated ginger and lime wedges if desired.
Make sure to cook the pork to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
